component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) end sub
sub drain() seen = [] for attempt = 0 to 8 msg = wait(50, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then seen.push(msg.getData()) end for m.top.report = seen.join(",") end sub
